lineas.texto: Imagine a stone that has listened to the sky since the world began.
It sits on the Mountain of *Flowers and Fruit*, across the eastern sea.
For ages, it drinks sunlight, moonlight and wind.
Then one morning, the stone *cracks open* like an egg.
Out climbs a monkey made of stone.
His eyes shoot *golden light* up to Heaven.
In the sky, the Jade Emperor looks down and shrugs.
It is nothing strange, he says. Let him be.
The stone monkey plays with the other monkeys.
One day, they find a huge *waterfall*.
Whoever jumps through and comes back, they shout, is king.
Nobody moves. Nobody can see behind the water.
Stay, because this jump starts everything.
The stone monkey closes his eyes and leaps.
Behind it, he finds a dry cave with stone beds.
He comes back, and every monkey bows. He is the *Monkey King*.
For three hundred years, he never worries.
Then, at a happy feast, the king starts to *cry*.
Why would a king cry? Part two, {when_next}.
